# @devhorizon/dls - LLM Documentation & Vibe-Coding Cheat Sheet
> Version: 1.0.0
> Designed for DevHorizon & AI-Assisted "Vibe Coding" (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude, Copilot, v0)

## Quick Summary
@devhorizon/dls is an enterprise Design Language System (DLS) built on React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It delivers a high-end luxury dark aesthetic inspired by WellSky Atlas, Linear, and Apple, featuring deep obsidian surfaces (#111315), shining brushed chrome metallic accents (#E8EAED), and architectural pure white contrast zones (#FFFFFF).

---

## 1. Installation & Imports
```tsx
import {
  DlsButton,
  DlsBadge,
  DarkSurfaceCard,
  WhiteServiceCard,
  DlsLogo,
  StatItem,
  ProcessTimeline,
  colors,
  gradients,
} from "@devhorizon/dls";
import "@devhorizon/dls/style.css";
```

---

## 2. Color Palette Tokens
| Token | Hex | Role | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Primary Background | `#111315` | Canvas & dark viewports | Main section background |
| Surface / Cards | `#24272B` | Containers & dark cards | Card panels, dialogs |
| Surface Elevated | `#1A1C1F` | Elevated popovers | Floating menus, dropdowns |
| Text Light | `#D4D8DE` | Primary legible copy | Headings, body text |
| Shining Silver | `#E8EAED` | Metallic Primary Accent | Buttons, glow highlights |
| Secondary Platinum | `#C0C5CC` | Secondary Accent | Subtitles, pill borders |
| White Sections | `#FFFFFF` | Architectural contrast | Services & process grids |

---

## 3. Core Component Library

### A. DevHorizonButton (DevHorizonTechButton / DlsButton)
Used for all call-to-actions.
- `variant="primary"`: Brushed silver metallic gradient with dark #111315 text, subtle bevel highlight, and hover glow.
- `variant="secondary"`: Obsidian dark surface with refined silver border.
- `variant="inverted"`: Dark button for placement inside white sections.
- `variant="ghost"`: Transparent with silver hover state.
- `size`: `"sm"` | `"md"` (default) | `"lg"`
- `shape`: `"pill"` (default) | `"rounded"`
- `showArrow`: boolean (renders smooth animated right arrow)

```tsx
// Primary CTA with Arrow
<DevHorizonButton variant="primary" size="lg" showArrow>
  Explore Our Services
</DevHorizonButton>

// Secondary Obsidian Action
<DevHorizonButton variant="secondary" size="md">
  Talk to Our Team
</DevHorizonButton>
```

### B. DlsBadge
Used for section overlines / eyebrow labels and status pills.
- `variant`: `"silver"` (default) | `"dark"` | `"light"` | `"outline"`
- `showDot`: boolean (renders animated pulsing dot)

```tsx
<DlsBadge variant="silver" showDot>
  TECHNOLOGY • PEOPLE • IMPACT
</DlsBadge>

<DlsBadge variant="light">
  OUR SERVICES
</DlsBadge>
```

### C. DarkSurfaceCard
Dark container card (#24272B) with 1px silver border highlight and hover lift.
```tsx
<DarkSurfaceCard hoverEffect={true}>
  <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white mb-2">Cloud Infrastructure</h3>
  <p className="text-sm text-[#8E95A0]">High-availability microservices.</p>
</DarkSurfaceCard>
```

### D. WhiteServiceCard
Architectural pure white card (#FFFFFF) with line icon, title, description, and "Learn More" arrow link.
```tsx
import { Code2 } from "lucide-react";

<WhiteServiceCard
  icon={<Code2 className="w-5 h-5" />}
  title="Custom Software Development"
  description="Tailored digital solutions built from the ground up for business goals."
  linkText="Learn More"
  onLinkClick={() => console.log("navigate")}
/>
```

### E. StatItem
Bold statistical metrics display.
```tsx
<StatItem
  value="21+"
  label="Team Members"
  subtext="Driven by expertise"
/>
```

### F. ProcessTimeline
4-step horizontal or responsive delivery workflow.
```tsx
<ProcessTimeline
  steps={[
    { number: "01", title: "Discover", description: "Understand your goals and requirements." },
    { number: "02", title: "Design", description: "Create scalable, user-centric solutions." },
    { number: "03", title: "Develop", description: "Build with precision engineering." },
    { number: "04", title: "Deliver", description: "Launch and support for long-term growth." },
  ]}
/>
```

### G. DlsLogo
Official 3D metallic brushed chrome emblem and typography lockup.
```tsx
// Horizontal navbar lockup
<DlsLogo size="md" variant="horizontal" asLink={true} to="/" />

// Large display mark
<DlsLogo size="lg" variant="full" />
```

---

## 4. Vibe-Coding AI Rules & Constraints
1. **Never use standard generic colors** (e.g., standard red, raw blue, bright purple). Stick strictly to the `@devhorizon/dls` tokens.
2. **Contrast Rhythm**: Structure pages with dark obsidian heroes (`#111315`), followed by crisp pure white architectural feature sections (`#FFFFFF`), followed by dark showcase sections.
3. **Typography**: Always use `font-sans` (Inter/Manrope). Use `tracking-tight` on headings and `tracking-[0.18em]` uppercase on eyebrows.
4. **Icons**: Use `lucide-react` with 1.5px to 2px stroke width.
